import json,os,pathlib,pwd,subprocess,shutil,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server')
svc='jellyfinpink'
def run(args,t=12):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t)
 return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()
def prop(name):
 c,s=run(['systemctl','show','jellyfin-pink.service','-p',name,'--value'])
 return s if c==0 else None
def check_dir(path):
 script='import pathlib,os,json,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); n=0; b=0; valid=p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink(); files=list(p.iterdir()) if valid else []; print(json.dumps({"exists":valid,"regular_file_count":sum(x.is_file() and not x.is_symlink() for x in files),"regular_file_bytes":sum(x.stat().st_size for x in files if x.is_file() and not x.is_symlink()),"writable":os.access(p,os.W_OK) if valid else False}))'
 c,v=run(['sudo','-n','-u',svc,'--','/usr/bin/python3','-c',script,str(path)])
 return json.loads(v) if c==0 else {'read_exit':c}
assert prop('User')==svc
c,xml=run(['sudo','-n','-u',svc,'--','cat',str(root/'config/encoding.xml')])
assert c==0
x=ET.fromstring(xml)
allowed=('TranscodingTempPath','EncoderAppPath','EncoderAppPathDisplay','EncodingThreadCount','HardwareAccelerationType','EnableHardwareEncoding','EnableThrottling','EnableSegmentDeletion','ThrottleDelaySeconds','SegmentKeepSeconds')
fields={k:x.findtext(k) for k in allowed}
configured=fields['TranscodingTempPath']
path=pathlib.Path(configured) if configured else root/'cache/transcodes'
assert path.is_absolute() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()),'cache path outside dedicated Jellyfin tree; stop'
r={'scope':'read-only production cache and encoding preflight; no media reads, deletions, configuration changes or provider requests','service_user':svc,'config_read':True,'encoding_fields':fields,'transcode_path_candidate':str(path),'path_is_configured':bool(configured),'cache_inventory':check_dir(path),'disk_free_bytes':shutil.disk_usage(root).free,'private_network':prop('PrivateNetwork'),'service_status':{name:run(['systemctl','is-active',name])[1] for name in ('vivoapk-backend.service','jellyfin-pink.service','nginx.service','postgresql.service')}}
print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
